bio: Right on Ballindamm, with a view of the Binnenalster and its fountain, the restaurant boasts a superb location. Inside, the place has an appealingly relaxed yet stylish feel, and the service is friendly and professional. Top-notch ingredients are beautifully prepared to create attractively presented dishes – don't miss the steak cuts from the grill (eg Black Angus sirloin or a 900g porterhouse). There are also seasonal specials, and seafood such as oysters and grilled fish. Order sides and sauces of your choice to accompany the dishes – our top tip if you are having beef is the chimichurri! For fine weather, there is a small terrace on the pavement in front of the restaurant....
